source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
When an enemy unit, other than a **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE** unit, makes a **[fall-back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back)** while **[engaged](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range)** with your unit, it is forced into the **desperate escape mode**. A **battle-shocked** escaping unit takes −1 on its **[hazard rolls](vsdata:core-rule/hazard-rolls)** for that move.

It is not stated whether "your unit" means any of your units or only this Wulfen unit.

trigger.event: enemy unit makes a fall-back move

clauses.appliesTo: hazard rolls for that fall-back move
